# Oracle primary loop (decommissioned)

This surface no longer chooses the next move, routes work, or grants execution
authority. Use CStar lifecycle state and CoS sequencing. The adjacent workflow
analyst remains an explicit read-only parser for legacy `tasks.md` and
`dev_journal.md` files; its output is evidence only.
